description: This PHP source file defines the ViewSearchView class, which extends ViewListView, for handling search view interfaces within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder. It manages layout editing, module title parameters, display rendering, and AJAX breadcrumb navigation for module search views.

classes.name: ViewSearchView
classes.description: A class extending ViewListView to manage search view layouts and AJAX navigation in SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, setting the layout if provided in the request.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for display, including module name and title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden to prevent default pre-display behavior.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search view, optionally in preview mode, using Smarty templates and AJAX.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds the AJAX breadcrumb navigation for the module or studio context.
